summary: Kling 3.0 video generation on RunComfy. Kling 3.0 (also called Kling V3.0) is Kuaishou Technology's third-generation multi-shot video model with native synchronized audio and consistent character identity across shots.
whenToUse: Use when generating text-to-video or image-to-video with Kling 3.0, choosing between its Standard, Pro and 4K tiers.
